title: Dragon's Lair
build: Software Projects disk, alternate D64 with LA–LJ files

records.c: Bank out ROM and I/O with $01=$34. Copy pages $60 through $9F to $C0 through $FF by advancing the high bytes of the load and store operands. Restore $37 and jump to $4401.
Select VIC bank $C000 with $D018=$3C and multicolour enabled. Set the background palette and copy four pages of colours from $C0C0. Enable the picture and then wait for fire.
Wait for the exact port 1 value $EF at $DC01. After it arrives call the KERNAL and jump to the relocation loop.
